hotel_entrance.name: Hotel Entrance
hotel_entrance.description: The hotel entrance with a revolving glass door. Red carpets lead east to reception, and a door leads south to a broom closet.

broom_closet.name: Broom Closet
broom_closet.description: A small broom closet smelling of bleach.

hotel_reception.name: Hotel Reception
hotel_reception.description: The hotel reception with a mahogany counter. Corridors lead east to the kitchen and south to the guest rooms.

hotel_kitchen.name: Hotel Kitchen
hotel_kitchen.description: The hotel kitchen with hot stoves and steel tables. Smells of food fill the room.

dining_room.name: Dining Room
dining_room.description: A quiet dining room with round tables and soft jazz playing in the background.

corridor_1.name: Corridor 1
corridor_1.description: A carpeted hallway in the south wing. Security cameras are mounted on the ceiling.

corridor_2.name: Corridor 2
corridor_2.description: A shadowy corridor leading toward the private suites.

VIP_Room.name: VIP Room
VIP_Room.description: A private VIP lounge with leather armchairs and cigar smoke in the air.

secret_corridor.name: Secret Corridor
secret_corridor.description: A secret corridor hidden behind wood paneling, protected by electronic locks.

secret_room.name: Secret Room
secret_room.description: The secret office of the syndicate boss, filled with security monitors and contraband crates.

undercover_agent.name: Agent Smith
dialogue: Agent, keep your voice down. We are on hostile ground.
I hid a Colt 1911 in the broom closet south of here. Use QUEST to receive your assignment.
The syndicate boss is holed up in a secret room in the south wing. Take out his guards first.

receptionist.name: The Receptionist
dialogue: Welcome to the Grand Hotel Mendoza, sir. May I assist you with your luggage?
I must inform you that the south wing is strictly reserved for our VIP guests.
If you are looking for dinner, the kitchen and dining room are located to the east.

chef.name: Kitchen Chef
dialogue: Try to touch my knives and you'll end up in tomorrow's stew!

bodyguard_1.name: Big Biceps
dialogue: Let this serve as a lesson to you: Nobody passes this corridor without the boss's permission.
Turn around before I break both your arms.

bodyguard_2.name: Big Guns
dialogue: VIP area is restricted. This is what happens to those who don’t know!
One more step toward the boss's quarters and I open fire again.

target.name: Mafia Boss
dialogue: So MI6 finally sent their best? You're too late, agent.
My syndicate controls this entire region. You will never walk out of here alive.

gather_weapons.description: Find the pistol in the closet and the knife in the kitchen, then bring them back.

neutralize_guards.description: Eliminate the 2 bodyguards patrolling the south corridors to secure the path.

defeat_boss.description: Infiltrate the secret room in the south wing and eliminate the Mafia Boss.
